questions.question: What new network architecture is proposed in 'Attention Is All You Need', and what two mechanisms does it dispense with?

questions.question: What BLEU score did the Transformer (big) model achieve on WMT 2014 English-to-German?

questions.rubric: Must give 28.4, cite abstract or section 6.1/Table 2.

questions.rubric: 8 heads and 64 for both key and value dimension.

questions.target: sine and cosine functions of different frequencies

questions.target: 41.8 BLEU
questions.rubric: 41.8 from the abstract (note: body says 41.0, asked separately in C bucket).

questions.question: How is training generative adversarial nets formulated as a game?
questions.target: minimax two-player game between generator G and discriminator D

questions.question: For a fixed generator G, what is the optimal discriminator D*_G(x)?
questions.target: p_data(x)/(p_data(x)+p_g(x))

questions.question: What is the global minimum value of the virtual training criterion C(G)?
questions.target: -log 4

questions.question: C(G) equals -log 4 plus twice which divergence?
questions.target: Jensen-Shannon divergence

questions.question: Which three datasets were adversarial nets trained on?
questions.target: MNIST, Toronto Face Database (TFD), CIFAR-10

questions.question: What value of k (discriminator steps per generator step) was used in the experiments?
What Parzen-window log-likelihood did adversarial nets achieve on MNIST?
Why train G to maximize log D(G(z)) rather than minimize log(1-D(G(z)))?
questions.target: stronger gradients early because log(1-D) saturates
questions.rubric: Saturation / stronger gradients; same fixed point.

questions.question: Do adversarial nets require Markov chains or unrolled approximate inference?
questions.target: No
questions.rubric: No Markov chains, no unrolled inference; backprop and forward sampling only.

questions.question: What is the 'Helvetica scenario' in adversarial nets?
questions.target: G collapses many z to the same x; D and G must stay synchronized
questions.rubric: Mode collapse from insufficient D updates.

questions.target: RAG-Sequence (same document for the whole sequence) vs RAG-Token (different document per token)

questions.question: Which Wikipedia dump is used as the non-parametric knowledge source?
questions.target: December 2018 dump

questions.question: How many documents are in the Wikipedia index and how long is each?
questions.target: 21M documents of 100 words each

questions.question: What Exact Match score does RAG-Sequence achieve on Natural Questions?

questions.question: Why does the Transformer scale dot products by 1/sqrt(d_k), and what happens for large d_k without scaling?

questions.target: O(1) vs O(log_k n) for ByteNet and O(n/k) for ConvS2S

questions.question: According to the complexity discussion, when is self-attention faster than recurrent layers?
questions.target: when sequence length n is smaller than representation dimension d

questions.question: Table 3 row (E) found learned positional embeddings nearly identical to sinusoids; why keep sinusoids?
questions.target: they may allow extrapolation to longer sequences

questions.question: Which checkpoint-averaging and beam settings were used for base versus big translation models?
questions.target: base last 5 checkpoints (10-min intervals); big last 20; beam 4, length penalty 0.6
questions.rubric: Both averaging counts plus beam and alpha.

questions.question: For English constituency parsing, how did depth/width and decoding settings differ from the base translation model?
questions.target: 4 layers, d_model=1024; beam 21, alpha 0.3, max output length +300

questions.question: What do Table 3 rows (A)-(D) conclude about heads, d_k, model size and dropout?
questions.target: single-head 0.9 BLEU worse; too many heads hurt; smaller d_k hurts; bigger models better; dropout helpful

questions.question: How do Proposition 1 and Theorem 1 connect the optimal discriminator to the global optimum?
questions.target: D* = p_data/(p_data+p_g); at p_g=p_data, D*=1/2 and C(G)=-log 4

questions.question: Why not optimize D to completion in the inner loop, and what is the practical alternative?
questions.target: prohibitive and overfits; alternate k D steps with one G step (k=1)

questions.question: How do the generator/discriminator activation choices support backprop-only training?
questions.target: generator rectifier+sigmoid, discriminator maxout+dropout; no feedback loops allows piecewise linear units

questions.question: Compare adversarial nets with Deep GSN on the MNIST and TFD Parzen scores.
questions.target: MNIST 225 vs 214; TFD 2057 vs 1890

questions.question: Per Table 2, how do adversarial nets compare with MCMC-based models on sampling and p(x) evaluation?
questions.target: no Markov chain for sampling; p(x) not explicitly represented, Parzen approximation

questions.question: What statistical advantage is claimed for updating G only through gradients flowing from D?
questions.target: input components not copied into generator parameters; can represent sharp/degenerate distributions

questions.question: List the extensions proposed in the conclusion / future work.
questions.target: conditional GAN, learned approximate inference, semi-supervised learning, efficiency improvements

questions.question: How does RAG-Sequence decoding approximate argmax and why need Thorough or Fast Decoding?
questions.target: beam search per document then marginalize; Thorough adds forward passes, Fast approximates for long outputs

questions.question: How does RAG's FEVER accuracy compare with state of the art and BART on 3-way and 2-way?
questions.target: 3-way 72.5 vs 76.8 SotA vs 64.0 BART; 2-way 89.5 vs 92.2 vs 81.1

questions.target: FEVER claims are entity-centric so word overlap works; differentiable retrieval is crucial for QA

questions.target: 82 world leaders; 70%/68% matched, 12%/4% mismatched; knowledge updated by replacing the index

questions.target: three logit models tried, none improved, mechanism omitted; MS-MARCO learns fixed retrieval for some questions
